content.text:
The test passes. 

The change was front-end only, since the backend already carried project `status` end-to-end (the `V22__project_status.sql` column, `ProjectView`/`ListProjects` returning it, and `/__test__/seed` accepting it). I added:

1. **`features/projects/statusFilter.slot.tsx`** — a new `*.slot.tsx` filling the `projects.toolbar` region with a `data-testid="project-status-filter"` select (All / ACTIVE / ON_HOLD / FINISHED). It owns the `projectStatus` URL search-param key, mirroring the existing tag-filter control.

2. **`features/projects/ProjectsList.tsx`** — reads the same `projectStatus` key and adds one clause to the existing `visible` filter, so the list keeps only projects at the chosen status (empty = all), exactly as it already does for `showArchived` and `projectTag`.

No schema, server, or pinned-scaffolding edits were needed, and the full-stack path was already in place.
